N.G2.sub_2digit_borrow.title: Does the child understand borrowing or not?
N.G2.sub_2digit_borrow.tell: 2/2 correct → mistake was carelessness; 1/2 → practice borrowing again; 0/2 → basics are weak.
items: Question: Did you borrow to take 16 away from 40? From where?

L.G1.matra_basic.title: Does not know the vowel sign or does not know the word?
L.G1.matra_basic.tell: 1/4 correct in English but correct in home language → it's a language issue; low in both → basics of vowel sign are weak.
items: Say a word in your home language that has the 'aa' sound

L.G1.vyanjan.title: Which letters are getting mixed up?
L.G1.vyanjan.tell: Mistake in s/sh → make pairs using cards.

L.G2.all_matras.title: Which vowel signs are getting mixed up?
L.G2.all_matras.tell: Whichever is weaker in the pair → practice that same pair.

N.G2.place_value_99.title: Does the child know tens and ones?
